gloss: to frown, to knit one's brows

definitions.gloss: to frown, to knit one's brows
definitions.explanation: To draw the eyebrows together in an expression of displeasure, concern, or disapproval.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{眉|まゆ}をひそめた。
{眉|まゆ}をひそめる⟦ような→ような：30292_youna⟧⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{控|ひか}えて→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please refrain from behavior that would make people frown.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{課長|かちょう}→課長：01075_kachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{眉|まゆ}をひそめた。
examples.english: The section chief frowned upon hearing the report.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大声|おおごえ}→大声：09592_oogoe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{眉|まゆ}をひそめた。
examples.english: The other passengers frowned at the person talking loudly on the train.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{無礼|ぶれい}→無礼：15041_burei⟧な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦たち→たち：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦みな→みな：01810_mina⟧{眉|まゆ}をひそめた。⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}づいていなかった→気付く：01933_kizuku⟧。
examples.english: The senior colleagues all frowned at his rude behavior. He was the only one who didn't notice.

notes:
STRUCTURE: {眉|まゆ} (eyebrow) + を + ひそめる (to draw together, to contract). ⟦ひそめる→ひそめる：28429_hisomeru⟧ occurs almost only in this phrase.

NUANCE: Silent disapproval or concern — the reaction to something improper, worrying, or distasteful. It is a description of how others react, not an accusation, so it is a common way to report disapproval without criticizing directly. The person frowning is usually a bystander.

REGISTER: Slightly literary. It appears far more often in writing and in narration than in everyday speech, where ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しかめる→しかめる：10351_shikameru⟧ is the ordinary way to say the same thing.

RELATED WORDS:

- {眉|まゆ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to raise one's eyebrows — surprise
- {眉|まゆ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧: to furrow the brows — close in meaning to ひそめる
